REBUTTALS_DATA.customer_says: I’m happy with my current provider.
REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Absolutely, Sir. I’m not asking you to change today—just let me check if I can save you money. What rate are you currently on?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Acknowledge satisfaction, pivot immediately to rate comparison without pushing a commitment.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Fair enough. Just one thing—if I could reduce your processing cost, would you at least compare the figures?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Low friction challenge: ask for comparison only, not an immediate switch.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: No problem. When does it expire? I can simply check back closer to the renewal.
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Collect contract expiry date to schedule a warm callback before automatic rollover.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Got you. What are they charging you overall—rate plus any terminal rental? Because with us, there's no contract, no rental—just 1.25% per transaction.
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Worldpay frequently charges separate terminal rental (£15-£30/mo) and PCI compliance fees.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Sure. Roughly how much are you processing monthly? I’ll tell you straight away if switching would make sense.
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: SumUp charges a flat 1.69% - 1.75%. Any merchant doing >£1,500/mo saves substantially on Shift4 (1.25% or 0.70%).

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: I understand. What rate are you currently getting?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Direct inquiry: often the customer doesn't know their blended rate or includes hidden fees.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Of course. Just so I send something relevant—roughly what’s your monthly card turnover?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Qualify before emailing so you can send exact savings calculations instead of generic spam.

REBUTTALS_DATA.customer_says: I need to speak to my partner.
REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Absolutely. Before you do, what would they need to know to make the decision?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Arm the advocate with key figures (annual savings, zero rental, no contract).

REBUTTALS_DATA.customer_says: I don’t want to change machines.
REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: That’s fine. The machine is the easy part—the main point is what you’re paying to process each transaction.
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Shift the focus from the physical hardware swap to recurring cashflow savings.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Perfect. Then let’s focus purely on your transaction rate—what percentage are you currently paying?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: If they have purchased hardware (e.g. Zettle/SumUp/Square), their transaction rate is usually high (1.75%+).

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: It depends on your turnover, Sir. What are you roughly doing in card payments each month?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Anchor pricing to their turnover tier: 1.25% under £5k, 0.70% over £5k.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Even better—what’s the rough monthly amount? If the saving is tiny, I’ll tell you honestly.
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Disarms skepticism through transparency; with £0 rental, low turnover merchants avoid terminal bleed.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: I’ll take 20 seconds, Sir—who are you currently processing with?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Ask for only 20 seconds and a single piece of factual data.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: Absolutely. What time suits you better—later today or tomorrow?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Give binary choice (today or tomorrow) to lock in an explicit callback time.

REBUTTALS_DATA.agent_response: No problem. Who normally handles your card payments?
REBUTTALS_DATA.context: Identify the financial controller, owner, or director by name and best contact time.

opening.title: Attention Grabbing Opening
opening.script: Hi Sir, good afternoon! {agent_name} here, Key Accounts Manager. I’ll keep it brief—we’re helping UK businesses cut their card-machine costs, so I just wanted to check who you’re currently using?

branches.script: Got you. And are you paying a monthly rental on that? Because with us, there’s no contract, no rental—just 1.25% per transaction. Just so I can see if it’s actually worth your time, Sir—roughly what’s your monthly card turnover?
Fair enough, Sir. Just give me 20 seconds—if I can’t show you a saving, I’ll get out of your way.
Absolutely. Just one figure so I don’t waste your time—what’s your approximate monthly card turnover?
That’s good to hear. I’m not here to fix something that isn’t broken—I just want to see if we can make the same setup cheaper.

closer_rules: Ask questions instead of giving a long explanation.
Find out the current provider, rate/fees and approximate monthly card turnover.
Use the customer’s answer to continue the conversation rather than jumping into a full pitch.
Keep the first response short—aim to earn another 10–20 seconds.
Never claim a competitor charges a specific fee unless you have confirmed it applies to that customer’s agreement.
